items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Papa was 16 and quit and turned the band over to Sam Morgan.

ctx.x: When you were 16, you gave up then. Papa was 16 and quit and turned the band over to Sam Morgan. Yes, sir. That same Sam Morgan, see, that. Well, Sam Morgan took the band. So, he got to be famous, Sam Morgan. But when Papa died, Sam Morgan took over all the dad.
And who was that man? Huh? He used to do with Daddy. They used to call Wooden Joe.

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: Albert never had the pleasure of playing with Sam Morgan band. I could.

ctx.x: Wouldn't let Albert play. Wouldn't let Albert play. Run him off the music stand. Never would leave Albert play on any job. Albert never had the pleasure of playing with Sam Morgan band. I could.
Yeah, it's strange he wouldn't let his brother play. Like you say, some of them, I guess I thought it was a good rule to stick, for the whole band
